notes.title: New Game Mode: Free-For-All Update and More
notes.content:
Hello Gorilla fighters,



The first update is here and we added some sweet new content! But first of all, I'd like to thank all of you who've played so far and the nice reviews you guys have written. Was a blast reading them and was honestly so fun seeing you guys playing the game so far!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606262/5b3a24684e90585dbc6a4bde4e06099c9f09fbd6.gif"]

In this update:

Major addons:

New game mode: Free-for-all

Brand new Map: Free-for-all Arena1 (More maps coming!)

Minor addons:

Added Sprinting to the Combat Man character (The one used in the game modes)

Lobby addons:

Added a funny Vendor character to whom you can talk to purchase cosmetics.

Bug fixes:

Apparently there was an issue that the max session/server side was 16 players. Attempted to fix that so the game should actually support 100+ players per session now.



More fun updates coming very very soon (This week)! Working on it day by day, my next aim is to have plenty more of the funny pre-made characters available for play this week! That will overall make the entire game have so much more content.



Thanks everyone and for any feedback please join the Discord link in the game on the main menu!



OOGAAA BOOOOGAAA



We out!
